injury.description: Apr 13: Draisaitl (lower body) participated in Monday's morning skate and should return to the lineup sometime in the opening round of the playoffs, Tony Brar of Oilers TV reports.
Apr 16: Hughes (illness) will fly with the team for Game 1 in Dallas, according to Michael Russo of The Athletic.
Apr 8: Kuzmenko (knee) is making strides in his recovery and will be reevaluated in 7-8 days, Alexander Legget of Mayors Manor reports Wednesday.
Apr 17: Carrier (upper body) participated in Friday's practice session on the second defensive pairing, Marc Antoine Godin of Radio-Canada reports.
Jan 21: Abols' injury is a fractured right ankle, Kevin Kurz of The Athletic reports Wednesday.
